source_refs.note: Exercise 1.2, Question 1 (book p. 14): pick the algebraic functions; answer key p. 297

blocks.prompt: 1. Which of the following functions are algebraic? \(f(x) = \sec x\), \(g(x) = \frac{2x-3}{x+1}\), \(h(x) = \sqrt{x^{2}+2x}\), \(k(x) = \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\), \(r(x) = (x-1)^{3}\)
blocks.explanation:
Dekhiye, yeh classification (darja bandi) ka sawal hai: paanch functions diye hain aur har ek ke baare mein faisla karna hai ke woh algebraic hai ya nahin.
Diya kya hai? Paanch functions \(f, g, h, k, r\).
Find kya karna hai? In mein se algebraic kaun se hain.
Kaunsa rule? Section 1.3 ki definition: function algebraic hai agar woh \(x\) se sirf jama, tafreeq, zarb, taqseem aur roots (jaise square root) ke zariye, mehdood dafa istemal kar ke, banaya ja sake. Yani \(y = f(x)\) ek polynomial equation ko satisfy kare. Jis mein trigonometric, exponential, logarithmic ya hyperbolic hissa ho woh transcendental hai.
Plan: ek ek function utha kar is kasauti (test) par parkhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = \sec x\), \(g(x) = \frac{2x-3}{x+1}\), \(h(x) = \sqrt{x^{2}+2x}\), \(k(x) = \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\), \(r(x) = (x-1)^{3}\).
Maloom karna: in mein se algebraic functions kaun se hain.
Tareeqa: har function ko definition se check karenge: kya yeh sirf \(+, -, \times, \div\) aur roots se ban sakta hai? Agar haan, to woh polynomial equation bhi likh denge jo yeh satisfy karta hai, taa ke saboot pakka ho.

\(f(x) = \sec x\)
\[\sec x = \dfrac{1}{\cos x}\]
Transcendental.
Kyun: is mein trigonometric function \(\cos x\) hai. \(\cos x\) ko \(x\) se sirf jama, zarb, taqseem ya roots ke zariye nahin banaya ja sakta; yeh angle ka function hai. Is liye \(\sec x\) algebraic nahin.

\(g(x) = \frac{2x-3}{x+1}\)
\[y = \dfrac{2x-3}{x+1}\]
\[(x+1)y - (2x-3) = 0\]
Algebraic.
Kyun: yeh do polynomials ki taqseem (rational function) hai. Cross-multiply karne se \(x\) aur \(y\) ki ek seedhi polynomial equation mil gayi. Definition ki shart poori ho gayi.

\(h(x) = \sqrt{x^{2}+2x}\)
\[y = \sqrt{x^{2}+2x}\]
\[y^{2} - (x^{2}+2x) = 0\]
Algebraic.
Kyun: is mein sirf ek polynomial ka square root hai, aur root lena algebraic operation hai. Dono taraf square karne se root khatam ho gaya aur polynomial equation bach gayi.
Dhyan dein: root dekh kar ghabraiye mat; roots algebraic hi hote hain.

\(k(x) = \frac{e^{x}-e^{-x}}{2}\)
\[k(x) = \sinh x\]
Transcendental.
Kyun: yahan \(x\) exponent (power) mein baitha hai: \(e^{x}\). Jab variable power mein ho to function exponential hai, aur exponential algebraic nahin hota. Yeh asal mein \(\sinh x\) hai.

\(r(x) = (x-1)^{3}\)
\[y - (x-1)^{3} = 0\]
Algebraic.
Kyun: \((x-1)^{3} = x^{3} - 3x^{2} + 3x - 1\), seedha polynomial hai. Har polynomial algebraic hota hai.
Tasdeeq: kitab ki answer key bhi \(g\), \(h\) aur \(r\) ko algebraic functions batati hai. Hamara jawab bilkul mil gaya.
blocks.final_answer: Algebraic functions \(g(x) = \frac{2x-3}{x+1}\), \(h(x) = \sqrt{x^{2}+2x}\) aur \(r(x) = (x-1)^{3}\) hain. (\(f\) aur \(k\) transcendental hain.)
